'''Kombat Duel League''' is a 1on1 double-elimination bracket league run by {{Player|alice|flag=se}}, starting April 19, 2022. While match scheduling is done in old fashioned quakeworld manners, the maps are a mix of brand new kenya and standard maps. Each match always start with map [[Zerg]] (followed by normal pick order) which is a clever way of introducing the just released map into action, giving every player equal conditions.
== Format ==
* Double-elimination bracket
** {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} matches
** {{Abbr|BO5|Best of 5}} all matches in Final Bracket
** Max 4 days of scheduling per round
* Map order:
** Start map is always [[Zerg]]
** Remaining map pool is: [[Bravado]] [[DM4]] [[Aerowalk]] [[ZTNDM3]]
** 2nd map picked by loser of 1st map
** 3rd map picked by the other player.
** In best of 5: 4th picked by whoever is down 1-2, and remaining map as decider.

== Rules ==
* Map order:
** Start map is always [[Zerg]]
** 2nd map picked by loser of 1st map
** 3rd map picked by the other player.
** In best of 5: 4th picked by whoever is down 1-2, remaining map as decider.
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping)
* Client: ezQuake
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* If both players agree, same map can be picked twice.
* Forfeiting first map in a series may result in disqualification from tournament.
* Disqualification from tournament if match is failed to be schedule after 4 days.
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|alice|flag=se}}
